finalized_content: Synchronized sovereign VPS Hub KVM563 (/opt/camelot-ecosystem) to feat/invisioned-marketing-digital-factory at commit 8dba5e42: 1) Verified Sir Hermes (HERMES_PRIME) container, dashboard on :9119, gateway on :8642, and active 60s MGV research cycle timer. 2) Verified Sir Heimdall and restored Bifrost gateway (:3001) with clean DATABASE_URL binding in apps/bifrost/.env. 3) Rebuilt and verified apps/bifrost (Prisma Client + tsc) and apps/excalibur-cmd-1 production client bundle (96.82 kB). 4) Verified active services: camelot-bifrost (PID 1477013), camelot-vps-mesh (:8095), camelot-edge-bus, camelot-watchtower (60s tick timer), and camelot-hermes-prime. 5) Confirmed end-to-end socket reachability probe from Cybertronia to VPS (100.110.180.18:3001) in 117ms with nominal heartbeat.
